prompt: 3 days in Lisbon: what to see and eat

plan.title: 3 Days in Lisbon: What to See and Eat
plan.description: A quick three-day plan for Lisbon, from hilltop viewpoints and old tram streets to riverside sights and custard tarts. Learn what to see each day and what to taste along the way.

beats.narration: Lisbon is a city of seven hills, and the best way to meet it is slowly. On day one, wander Alfama's narrow lanes, ride a yellow tram, and climb to a viewpoint at sunset.

clip_queries: aerial view of city rooftops at sunset
props.alt: yellow tram in historic city street

beats.narration: Day two follows the river. Walk to Belem to see the tower and the monastery, then stand beside the big bridge. Afterwards, queue for a warm custard tart dusted with cinnamon.

props.alt: Lisbon riverside sights and custard tarts

beats.narration: Day three is for flavor. Eat grilled sardines and salted cod, sip a small coffee at a corner cafe, then take a short train to a fairytale palace in the hills nearby.

clip_queries: coffee served at a street cafe

beats.chapter: Day three: flavors and day trip

beats.narration: So the plan is simple. Day one, hills and trams. Day two, the river and the tarts. Day three, fish, coffee, and a palace. Lisbon rewards anyone who walks, tastes, and takes their time.
